answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 148379 Country: India Title: Does breast feeding invalidate wudhu? Question: Does breast feeding invalidate wudhu? Answer ID: 148379 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 553/495/M=4/1438) It invalidates wudhu if any impure thing discharges from body. The milk is not impure hence wudhu will not break by breastfeeding the child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
